{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_0/silicon_melting.in", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for silicon melting simulation
# Units: metal (eV, Angstrom, ps, K, bar)

units           metal
atom_style      full
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       silicon.data

# Replicate 3x3x3
replicate       3 3 3

# Define potential - Stillinger-Weber
pair_style      sw
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/SW/Si.sw Si

# Neighbor settings
neighbor        2.0 bin
neigh_modify    every 1 delay 0 check yes

# Timestep
timestep        0.001  # 1 fs

# Compute MSD for diffusion coefficient calculation
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Thermodynamic output
thermo_style    custom step temp press density pe ke etotal vol c_msd[4]
thermo          1000

# ============================================
# Stage 1: Initial equilibration at 300K (short)
# ============================================
velocity        all create 300.0 12345 dist gaussian
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             10000  # 10 ps
unfix           1

# ============================================
# Stage 2: Heating from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps
# ============================================
# Temperature change: 2200 K
# Rate: 2.2 K/ps
# Time needed: 2200/2.2 = 1000 ps = 1000000 steps

fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run             1000000  # 1000 ps heating
unfix           2

# ============================================
# Stage 3: Equilibration at 2500K for 500 ps
# ============================================
# Reset MSD compute before production run
uncompute       msd
compute         msd all msd com yes

# Reset time origin for MSD calculation
reset_timestep  0

fix             3 all npt temp 2500.0 2500.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
dump            1 all custom 10000 equilibration.dump id type x y z vx vy vz
dump_modify     1 sort id

run             500000  # 500 ps equilibration
unfix           3
undump          1

# Write final configuration
write_data      final_structure.data

print           "Simulation completed successfully"
"}

{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/melting/task/level_1/brief/silicon_melting_1_trial_0/calculate_diffusion.py", "content": "import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the equilibration data
data = pd.read_csv('equilibration_data.csv')

# Extract time (in ps) and MSD (in Angstrom^2)
# In LAMMPS metal units: timestep = 0.001 ps
time_ps = data['Step'] * 0.001  # Convert steps to ps
msd_angstrom2 = data['c_msd[4]']

# Remove the first few points to avoid initial transients
# Use data from 50 ps onwards for linear fitting
mask = time_ps >= 50.0
time_fit = time_ps[mask].values
msd_fit = msd_angstrom2[mask].values

# Fit a linear regression to MSD vs time
# MSD = 6*D*t, so slope = 6*D
coeffs = np.polyfit(time_fit, msd_fit, 1)
slope = coeffs[0]  # Angstrom^2/ps

# Calculate diffusion coefficient
# D = slope / 6 (in Angstrom^2/ps)
D_angstrom2_ps = slope / 6.0

# Convert to m^2/s
# 1 Angstrom = 1e-10 m
# 1 ps = 1e-12 s
# So 1 Angstrom^2/ps = 1e-20 / 1e-12 m^2/s = 1e-8 m^2/s
D_m2_s = D_angstrom2_ps * 1e-8

print(f"Linear fit from {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps")
print(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps")
print(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s")
print(f"\nFinal answer: {D_m2_s:.2e}")

# Create a plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
plt.plot(time_ps, msd_angstrom2, 'b-', linewidth=2, label='MSD data')
plt.plot(time_fit, np.polyval(coeffs, time_fit), 'r--', linewidth=2, 
         label=f'Linear fit (slope={slope:.4f} Å²/ps)')
plt.xlabel('Time (ps)', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('MSD (Å²)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Mean Squared Displacement vs Time at 2500K', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('msd_plot.png', dpi=150)
print("\nPlot saved as msd_plot.png")

# Save results to file
with open('diffusion_coefficient.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(f"Diffusion Coefficient Calculation for Liquid Silicon at 2500K\n")
    f.write(f"=" * 70 + "\n\n")
    f.write(f"Linear fit range: {time_fit[0]:.1f} ps to {time_fit[-1]:.1f} ps\n")
    f.write(f"Slope of MSD vs time: {slope:.6f} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_angstrom2_ps:.6e} Angstrom^2/ps\n")
    f.write(f"Diffusion coefficient: {D_m2_s:.6e} m^2/s\n")
    f.write(f"\nFinal answer (m^2/s): {D_m2_s:.2e}\n")

print("\nResults saved to diffusion_coefficient.txt")
"}
